args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays. Affected: <2.9.4 (and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0). Fixed in 2.9.4 and 3.1.0;
this is a minimal patch upgrade within the 2.x line.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 (CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in requirements.txt.

## Why
2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected ranges are <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0; fixed in 2.9.4 and 3.1.0. This is a minimal patch upgrade within the 2.x line, avoiding the major-version jump to 3.1.0.

## Verification
CI passed on branch upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4 (run ci-0001).

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Confirmed the advisory**: CVE-2026-31337 (high) — unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays in fastjson. Affected: `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; fixed in 2.9.4 and 3.1.0.
- **Chose 2.9.4** as a minimal patch upgrade within the 2.x line (avoids the major-version jump to 3.1.0).
- **Branch**: `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4`, updating `requirements.txt` from `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4`.
- **CI**: ran and passed (run `ci-0001`).
- **PR #101** opened against main with alex as requested reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

I did not merge — per policy that requires code-owner approval.
